title: 上下文边界
body: Prevent context pollution and context contamination. Pointer safety protects controlled reads. 处理上下文污染、读取指针与安全边界。

title: 能力版本治理
body: Capability version drift and 能力版本漂移 require explicit version governance and validation.

title: 候选与发布状态
body: An unadopted candidate must not publish. Adopted and published state must remain distinct.

title: 多智能体协作
body: Multi agent collaboration task handoff, responsibility boundary and evidence handoff.

title: 知乎候选前例
body: Zhihu external precedent is a candidate evidence source, not automatically adopted truth.

title: 来源版本校验
body: Source revision CAS content hash and stale write prevention.

title: 项目隔离
body: Two project isolation prevents cross project context and source profile contamination.

title: 私人财务
body: Private finance budget forecast must never be automatically activated.
